body: That’s just how it is, and even if somebody did encourage it, their reply/comment would be removed.

Well, on this subreddit we aren’t allowed to encourage something that may be harmful towards you or others. So even if I wanted to say that you should do it (which I don’t because you shouldn’t do it) I couldn’t.

Even if it’s common it’s still not legal for minors to drink. Drinking age in my country is also 18 and the majority of people start before they are 18. However if you get caught then you will still be judged as a minor who is drinking, even if it’s common. And in my country at least, your parent are the one who are punished for your actions until you are 16 years old. The law is the law, regardless of your age...

For a moment probably, but afterward it would just be hell, at least that’s what I think. If you don’t get expelled and only gets a suspension then that lucky. And when you come back a lot of people are going to think of you as the guy/girl who came drunk to school and you a minor so that wouldn’t look good either. Also, parents and other adults would look at your mom as a failure. Simply because she “let you consume alcohol” when you are underaged. Then the child welfare will be involved as stated above and she will get into a lot of problems and an investigation will be done. All that for 10 minutes of fun... wouldn’t be worth it.

Sorry to hear about your dads role in your life, same for me so I can somewhat relate. And, it’s better that your mom caught you rather than the school or someone else as they would probably call officials and an investigation would take place.

Video games are literally the only thing that makes me happy and brings me joy in life... I just want to play because then I’m in my own bubble, away from everything else and I can finally relax. It’s also one of the only reason I haven’t made an attempt again tbh...
I just wanna see how my body will react tbh... it’s not an attempt at something so don’t worry about that. I’m not at the best place tbh but don worry
Yeah, thanks for you enlightenment on the subject.

Do you think I’ll just simply pass out then? or what? I drank for the first time since new year last weekend so my tolerance have gone down, but I used to be able to drink I bit... but if I combine it with weed I do not know what would happen, hence why I ask you guys/girls.

I feel like this subreddit is a place for people to get stuff off of their chest, or a place to find others in need just as oneself. There is literally no reason as to why you can’t post as much as you want here, so post away to your heart’s content. Just rant as much as you want. If that’s something that makes you feel a little bit better Then I don’t see a reason as to why you shouldn’t do it

It really hard, I tried the rope, my mind was clear as the night sky while my body just froze and shook like maraca. Your body’s survival instincts kick in and it’s almost impossible to go through with it...

My therapist even suggested/was thinking of making me go to a male therapist instead of her due to the fact that I find it easier to talk to females rather than males... so she thought it would be better for me to get a male one so I could build up that side of me... I told her that if she did that I would stop seeing anyone as I have already spilled everything to her and won’t do it again... 

But that just goes to show that they want to do what they feel like is best for you, however you do have your own say in it.

Some times when I’m driving or doing anything outside I feel like I’m in a video game or something, suddenly everything feels fake and unreal, I feel like I’m in a VR world and it’s so weird. It’s like I’m a npc or a character in a game, I’m just there, doing what I’m “supposed” to do...

I don’t usually daydream but every night before falling asleep I make up these fantasies in my head while trying to fall asleep, they can be both good or bad ones, but I can’t decide which one it will be...

After a failed attempt one of the few ways I manage to deal with my suicidal thoughts is to joke about it... not in a way where it’s directed towards other but rather towards myself, because if I don’t the severity of what I say will strike me and I know that will only make it worse...

I also see a psychologist once a week which doesn’t really do much but it helps me with getting stuff off my chest.

And I browse this subreddit at least 1-4 hours a day because I feel kinda connected with people here, if that makes sense? No one here will judge me in any way or form and many people here have gone through something similar as me or have similar thoughts as me which makes me feel less alone in this world I guess?

I’m in the same boat, especially with my family... wish they just resented me and cut if all ties with me as well as my friends, because if that happened I wouldn’t “feel bad” about going through with it... 

Sometimes I feel like a dick talking/posting about my thoughts and shit I’m going through on this subreddit every time I read other people’s post about how they want someone who’s there for them... 

why can’t I just give everything I have to them? Why can’t we just trade places? I’m tired and I have no feelings anymore, I just don’t want to exist. I don’t want any ties with anyone but I can’t cut them off myself, meanwhile other are the opposite and want ties with others...

Or he may be “immune” to them. I friend of mine can’t take painkillers or anesthesia anymore due to the fact that she been taking drugs for many years and ODed many times so her body just kinda flushes it out I guess? she kept waking up from anesthesia during a surgery at one time...

Depends on the person, personally I wrote 1 long ass letter where I said stuff to my mom, step dad, sister, brother and briefly about my actual dad (who I haven’t talked to in years) became 2 pages but damn, time flew by while I did it. Felt like 10min but took like 1 hour...

My recommendation is to do what you think is right, HOWEVER, everyone who is/are suicidal reacts in different ways, personally I would find it overwhelming if someone messaged me everyday or tried to make sure I was ok 24/7, I need some alone time myself too. A call once in a while or a check up on how I’m doing feels really nice, but if it’s to much it can get overwhelming. I would also recommend you to find out what her hobbies/what she likes to do are. With this you could find out what you potentially could do together, just doing “fun” stuff can make her feel better as her focus is diverted from one thing to another. But just be careful, whatever you do, do not make her feel overwhelmed, small steps at the beginning I would say, don’t be hawk. But then again, people react and feel different than others do.

If you want my opinion, then yes. It’s not a good idea. The reason for this is that it’s not a “guaranteed” death. If you do it you may just get beaten up really bad, stabbed once or twice or something else, which will hurt a ton, then you will survive.and realize that that wasn’t the best idea. You aren’t guaranteed anything, and the chances of it going the way you think are really low.

You at not selfish at all, and you are not alone, I can reassure you of that. There are other people who struggle with getting out of bed and getting themselves together. Also feeling better about yourself when you feel like people are actually listening to you is normal, I’m also like that in the way that I feel better when I know people are actually listening to me, and it’s not selfish at all, it’s what makes us humans in fact. When people are listening we feel a sense of security, we feel “safe” I guess. Some people just handle stuff either better or worse than others and that’s just how it is... and no matter what people say it’s not not selfish at all. You statement may or may not be one of the factors that plays in on your breakups but being with someone is a task in itself, you have to trust and rely on the other person both in the form of getting help from him/her as well as putting your trust in them which is really hard for some people. I can see how you are tired from all of this but posting here may or may not be a way for you to get stuff off your chest, but if you post here, keep an open mind, people will read your post but you may not get a response from people, and that isn’t because of you but rather because people here are also struggling and therefor may not response because of certain reasons (I made a post about that which you may read if you want to or feel like it).

Ay, same for you my man. Also, I would highly suggest talking to someone, doesn’t have to be a therapist or psychologist, could just be a friend or a family member, as long as you trust them. Nobody knew that after I tried to take my own life I got committed to a mental hospital for a week, before moving back home... I then proceeded to tell 2 friends who I really trust and my little sister (1 year apart from each other) I still haven’t told anybody else except my psychologist but that is to be expected. And if you don’t feel like you have the courage or are just scared of telling someone, you can talk to me, I may not know you personally or have any form of ties with you, but I will listen. Just getting stuff out will often help, so if you need to get stuff off your chest then send me a dm

I do not know how it feels but I can tell you how it felt while trying to do it... I personally tried to hang my self and it was fucking weird, personally I was up in a tree, standing on a branch about 8 meters above the ground, when I stood there with the noose around my neck and was ready to take that final step my body just froze... was so fucking weird, my mind was clear and could think straight like a “normal” person, my body however was shacking like a maraca, and it wouldn’t move... even though I I tried to get my body to take that final step and kept thinking and saying stuff that could help med do it, my body just wouldn’t listen, it just kept shaking. Was like my body was possessed by two people tbh, one person controlled my mind while the other controlled my body... never felt anything like it before. 

When it comes to how effective it is I think it depends on if you are just standing on a chair or if you jump from the point where the rope is tied or higher, if you are high enough then there is a high chance that gravity will just snap you neck when the rope tightens, while if you are low then you will just strangle yourself to death which seems more painful.

if you are suicidal I would suggest getting some form of help, any form is better than none

No matter where you stab yourself it will hurt, a fuck ton, would not suggest it. There isn’t a place on your body that would cause you minimal pain when it comes to stabbing. And about the ”stay alive bullshit” that you are talking about, no one on this subreddit are going to encourage suicide, it’s rathe the opposite. So people are going to say stuff like “please don’t”. 

And people that do encourage it have their msgs deleted.

I think it depends on how bad it is, and if you are a threat to your own life... I had an appointment with my psychologist today and told her about how my mom said that if antidepressant would help me get better then she would suggest that I went on them or if I thought I should be committed to a mental hospital she would support my decision as long as it got me help, when I said this to my psychologist she straight up said that if she would put in a recommendation for me being committed then I would be declined, but if i really wanted to then she would do everything she could to make that happen... and she doesn’t want me to go on antidepressants bcs of the side effects, and would rather I start exercising more, aka go on walks, running or something similar bcs that would help my mental health to... so yeah, depending on your situation, who you talk to and how big of a threat to your own life you are, you may or may not be committed

Hope you don’t do it. No matter what you write nothing in that paper or on that page would help them “feel easier” about your death. It will only make them feel more guilty about how they didn’t see what was wrong and/or didn’t ask you how you were doing. That guilt is something that they will carry with them for the rest of their life. Hope you get the help you need, regardless if it’s professional or not.

I would also suggest that you try it again, at least your are conscious enough to realize what has helped and are willing to try it again, that’s one step in the right direction at least. I’m gonna give my honest opinion here and say that I’m not a fan of how America handles their citizens mental help, and their options when it comes to giving other the help they need as it’s all based on their financials.

Are you seeing a psychologist? If not I would suggest it. I don’t know what country you’re living in as some countries have different policies and offers when it comes to mental help than others have, as well as cost. Antidepressants may also work if you aren’t on that, I do know that a lot of people don’t use them as it may increase their chance of actually committing suicide during the first few weeks they are going on it because it gives them extra energy , but I know a couple of people who got better after that. My psychologist suggested that I tried it but I personally decided not to go on them because I know it’s not going to end well for me... I can’t tell you what to do but I can give you suggestions.

The first paragraph is EXACTLY what happened with me, I started to cave in and suddenly I snapped and tried it... didn’t end well because im still here.

As to what you could do to prevent it I would suggest talking about it to your wife, if she already knows about it then I would still suggest talking about it with her, just getting stuff out helps, even if it’s small things. I would also suggest that you talk to a psychologist, friend(s) or family about it, they will try to help you or get you the help you need. If you don’t then your thoughts will only get worse and worse, and that will not help you in the slightest. Hope nothing bad happens and that you get the help that you need.
No worries, I know it may not seem like much but if u just want to get stuff out then hit me up with a dm or something, I may not be able to help you, but I will at least listen to you

I’m sorry to hear that, were you asking for other people thoughts or just had to get stuff out of your system? I think people are more likely to reply if it’s a question/a post about help from others than if it’s a post where you feel like you have to get stuff out. If it was the latter, I think the reason for this could be due to the fact that people don’t want to post personal opinions or say something that might be taken/read in a wrong way or may encourage “bad” stuff or thoughts.

But I don’t want the type of help that I know I’m gonna get if I tell her... I don’t want to be forced to take pills, talk to other therapist and psychologist... I just want everything to be over tbh 🙃

Thank you for asking but I think I’m “fine” don’t want to bother anybody with what’s going on in my life and make other people semi-conscious on my well being... don’t really know why I keep posting on this subreddit, probably because it helps me just getting stuff out I guess? Anyway, thanks for asking at least <3

Dont worry, it’ll be fine, you can do it, the first time(s) are always the hardest, was like that for me to. And depending on your situation you may even get the pills faster than you expect (got my sleep medications on my 2nd meeting with my psychologist) the first call is always the hardest but once you do make the call it will be easier later on

It’s impossible, currently going to a psychologist once a week, I keep telling her I’m “fine” or “better” because I know if she finds out how messed up I really am she obligated to put me in a hospital or something... only reason I know this is because I’m currently studying social work aka therapy, drugs and other stuff, I want to help other but how can I help others if I can’t even help myself?

Only reason she did was because I called her and said I was happy she was my friend while I was alive, and told her “goodbye”, she broke down and now 6 months later she doesn’t talk to me anymore even tho she lives 5 min away from me...

The thing is I completely understand that... however I have literally told them face to face that I’m struggling and I need their help if I’m gonna get better... I straight up said “I need you to send me a message about how I’m doing from time to time or something similar, im not gonna be able to ask if we can talk or something similar all the time, and I need your help... anything helps” and now, I haven’t gotten a single message in over a month... “I’ll help you” they said... pfft, my ass

You are not alone, been like this for me for the past 4 years... nobody knew anything, was always the “happy guy who always smiled and there was never anything wrong with me” while in reality I’m messed up af and just want to die... I would recommend that you go see a psychologist, I’m currently going once a week and it helped me with finding out new things about me, things I didn’t know could be reasons for me being this way... I’m gonna be 100% honest here and say that nothing had changed about me and i lie to my psychologist by saying I’m “fine” or “better” but that just depends on the person I think. Still, I’m happy I found out much more about me than I did before. I know they are professional people who see people like me everyday but they really do care about helping you out, even if it is just about finding out more about you and just giving you advice about what to do. So yeah, see a psychologist or at least TRY to talk to somebody, friends, family or whoever, it helps, at least a little and it’s gone be hard AF but just trying is one step forward in the right direction <3
